metadata.question: Does the water in the southeastern coast of Guishan Island (24.83594812988359, 121.96499287870442) exhibit a lighter blue coloration than the northwestern coastal waters (24.84607374884142, 121.93452298429524) on September 29, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about water color comparison between two coastal locations around Guishan Island on a specific date (September 29, 2021). Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has good spatial resolution (10m) and visible bands for color analysis 2. Focus on the blue band (B2) to measure "lighter blue coloration" 3. Compare mean reflectance values at both locations 4. Handle cloud masking and data availability checks Data Collection: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI L2A (surface reflectance) for accurate color representation - Date: 2021-09-29 ± 1 day to account for potential cloud cover - Locations: Two points as specified Processing: - Extract blue band (B2) values - Apply cloud masking - Compare mean reflectance values - Higher blue reflectance = lighter blue color Validation: - Check if images exist for both locations - Check if valid pixels remain after masking - Ensure reflectance values are reasonable (0-1 range) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const southeastPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([121.96499287870442, 24.83594812988359]); const northwestPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([121.93452298429524, 24.84607374884142]); const date = '2021-09-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 L2A for accurate color const s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2021-09-28', '2021-09-30') .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([southeastPoint, northwestPoint])) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const s2ColSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images: ${s2ColSize}`); if (s2ColSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get least cloudy image const image = s2Col.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // 3. Processing - Focus on blue band (B2) for color analysis const blueBand = 'B2'; // Sample both points const seSample = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southeastPoint.buffer(30), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const nwSample = image.select(blueBand).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northwestPoint.buffer(30), scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const seValue = seSample.get(blueBand).getInfo(); const nwValue = nwSample.get(blueBand).getInfo(); console.log(`SE Blue Reflectance: ${seValue ? seValue.toFixed(4) : 'No data'}`); console.log(`NW Blue Reflectance: ${nwValue ? nwValue.toFixed(4) : 'No data'}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (seValue === null || nwValue === null) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (isNaN(seValue) || isNaN(nwValue) || seValue < 0 || seValue > 1 || nwValue < 0 || nwValue > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Higher blue reflectance = lighter blue color if (seValue > nwValue) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
